meta.title: Aura Academy
meta.tagline: Professional training in PMU and lamination
meta.description: Aura Academy by Amira Bechini, Giulianova (TE), Italy. Courses in microblading, powder brows, lip blush, PMU eyeliner and lash and brow lamination. Theory, hands-on practice, live model and post-course support, in classes of 3-4 students.

hero.sub: With a practical, complete method: theory, hands-on practice, a live model where scheduled and post-course support, in classes of three or four students.
hero.portrait: Amira Bechini, founder of Aura Academy

instructor.title: Amira Bechini
instructor.role: International PMU Master and Founder of Aura Academy
instructor.mission: To train competent professionals through practical courses, continuous support and high standards.
instructor.body: Aura Academy trains permanent makeup and lamination professionals in Giulianova, in the province of Teramo, Italy. Courses are taught in Italian, at base and advanced level, with a maximum of three or four students per session.

why.title: The same conditions for everyone
why.sub: They hold for every course in the catalogue, base and advanced.

groups.title: Classes of three or four
groups.body: The maximum number of students per course is three or four.

levels.title: Two levels
levels.body: Every technique is taught at base level and at advanced level.

language.title: Taught in Italian
language.body: Courses are held entirely in Italian.

kit.title: Professional kit
kit.body: Available on request. Where it is included, the price reflects it.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.body: A certificate is issued at the end of the course.

venue.title: On site
venue.body: Every course is held at the academy in Giulianova (TE).

method.title: How a course runs
method.sub: The same order every time, for every technique and both levels.

clips.mapping: From mapping to machine work, filmed at the academy.
clips.pigment: Blade and pigment, at working distance.

theory.title: Theory
theory.body: The theory behind the technique, before any hands-on work.

practice.title: Practice
practice.body: Guided hands-on work, followed step by step.

model.title: Live model
model.body: On the courses where one is scheduled, you work on a model under supervision.

support.title: Post-course support
support.body: We stay available after the course has finished.

courses.a: Microblading, Powder Brows, Lip Blush, PMU Eyeliner, Lash Lamination and Brow Lamination, at base and advanced level.

duration.a: Duration varies by the course chosen. We confirm it along with your quote.

price.q: How much does a course cost?
price.a: The price varies by the course chosen and whether a professional kit is included. Write to us for a quote.

includes.a: Theory, hands-on practice, a live model where scheduled, and post-course support.

kit.a: The kit is available on request. Where it is included, the course price reflects it.

students.q: How many students are on a course?
students.a: Three to four. Places are limited by design.

certificate.a: Yes, at the end of the course.

language.q: What language are the courses taught in?

booking.q: How do I book and how do I pay?
booking.a: Book on WhatsApp or through the contact form on this site. Your place is confirmed with a deposit, agreed between us; payment is by bank transfer, card or PagoDIL.

location.a: At the Aura Academy premises, Lungomare Rodi 20, 64021 Giulianova (TE), Italy.
